subject: Request: package authority + routing for Serena Wu (Senior LLM Engineer)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: package authority + routing for Serena Wu (Senior LLM Engineer)

Team —

Quick summary: we want to extend an offer to Serena Wu for Senior LLM Engineer on the Serving Runtime team. Interview loop finished yesterday; feedback is strong on problem solving and system design. Compensation ask: $270k base + $65k eq (4yr) + annual bonus target 15%. Candidate is asking for flexibility on base vs. eq split.

I’m requesting:
- Approval to use a market-competitive total cash target up to $320k (base + target bonus) with up to $65k equity carve-out.
- If needed, a one-time sign-on up to $30k to bridge counteroffers.

Please see attached calc and her resume. Marissa — can you confirm offer routing and if we need exec approval for the proposed package? Stephanie — would you review comp band/leveling and advise if this requires band elevation or an exception?

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: package authority + routing for Serena Wu (Senior LLM Engineer)

Karthik —

Thanks for the note and attachments. I reviewed the calc. Quick replies:
- Routing: this goes through Comp & Benefits then Exec signoff if any element is outside published band.
- Current band for "Senior LLM Engineer" tops at ~ $245k base + 40k eq typical; your ask exceeds the published band and will require a comp exception.
- If the total cash target stays <= $320k and equity <= $65k we can try for an expedited exception; this typically needs two approvers (Comp Partner + People Lead) and then an Exec signoff if above tolerance.

Action items I’ll take on:
1) I’ll frame the comp-exception memo and attach the candidate summary.
2) I’ll ask People Ops to pre-clear the sign-on authority cadence.
3) If you can provide target start date and counteroffer context that helps the business case.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sr. Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: package authority + routing for Serena Wu (Senior LLM Engineer)

Karthik / Marissa —

Reviewed Serena's interview notes and resume. Leveling call: candidate is borderline between Senior and Staff; technical scope aligns with Staff expectations in terms of cross-team influence but domain depth is Senior+.

Recommendation:
- Offer at Senior band with a clear 12 month performance milestone plan tied to an accelerated promotion review at the 9-12 month mark. This reduces long-term band risk and gives candidate upward mobility.
- Approve up to $30k sign-on to match competitive counter. For total comp above band, we’ll need comp-exception approval.

I can draft the leveling note and the milestone plan if you want.

Stef

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Comp-exception memo for Serena Wu (draft)

Lauren/Markus —

Attaching a draft comp-exception memo and the calc (attached in thread). TL;DR: candidate requires exception because requested base and equity place total package above Senior band. Business rationale: immediate impact on latency-critical runtime feature roadmap, positive interview consensus, and competitor timeline (counteroffer deadline: 2027-05-03).

Proposed approvals flow:
1) Comp Partner (Marissa) — memo + calc
2) People Lead (Lauren) — endorsement on hiring priority and org fit
3) Finance (Markus) — confirm budget headroom for FY27 hiring plan
4) Exec signoff (if above comp tolerance) — CEO/CTO or delegated HR Exec.

If you can both reply with quick approve/decline and any edits, I’ll route this into the approval queue today.

-Marissa

Attachments: Serena_Wu_total_comp_calc.xlsx, Serena_Wu_resume.pdf, offer_letter_draft_v1.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp-exception memo for Serena Wu (draft)

Marissa — I reviewed and approve routing. Budget check: Markus, please confirm whether we can absorb a $30k sign-on now and the incremental comp delta for FY27 hiring plan. If Finance flags constraints, we can reduce sign-on and use accelerated promo milestones as part of the offer.

Markus — please reply by EOD so we can hit candidate deadline. If all green, Marissa please route to Exec queue — I can endorse.

Lauren Bishop
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
